messages:
dina_sales: onboarding OrionHealth POC (dedicated) — Okta SCIM calls failing with 400 Bad Request on POST /Users. Logs show "Invalid attribute: userName". SAML NameID being sent as persistent uuid, not email.

ryan_se: tenant slug?

dina_sales: tenant=orion-health, okta-app-id=0oaZZ9xYk12345. Okta error snippet: {"error":"Bad Request","error_description":"Invalid attribute: userName"}

maya_idp: For our Dedicated tenants we require SCIM base path to include tenant: https://scim.redwood.com/<tenant>/Users . If customer pointed to root SCIM endpoint we return 403. Also we canonicalize email to lowercase before matching.

dina_sales: customer says they used default app template and set user.login -> userName. Their Okta mapping currently sends `User.login` as `Jon.Smith@ORION-HEALTH.COM` (mixed case). They also have SAML NameID set to persistent.

kevin_sre: two things to do: 1) Ensure SCIM base path includes tenant in Okta SCIM app settings. 2) Normalize emails: In Okta attribute mapping use expression `String.toLowerCase(user.email)` (or `user.email.toLowerCase()` depending on UI) for userName and emails.value. Also set SAML NameID format to EmailAddress and map to the same lowercased email.

ella_cust: we changed the SCIM url to include /orion-health, updated mappings to `String.toLowerCase(user.email)`. Still getting 422 duplicateExternalId.

support_bot: Notice: 422 code indicates externalId collision. Run support query to find existing entries.

ryan_se: run curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.com/internal/tenants/orion-health/users?filter=email:jon.smith@orion-health.com"
```

kevin_sre: Found two records: `jon.smith@orion-health.com` (console created) and `Jon.Smith@ORION-HEALTH.COM` (previous SCIM try). I'll normalize and merge, set primary to lowercase.

maya_idp: Also added validation on our side to accept persistent NameID if there's a matching email attribute in SCIM payload; otherwise we force reject and return clear message telling IdP to switch NameID to EmailAddress.

dina_sales: customer applied changes; Okta shows 201 Created and users appear in tenant. 

ella_cust: confirmed users synced. Thanks team!

ryan_se: I'll add a short note to the POC onboarding checklist: "Okta SCIM: include tenant path, lowercase email mapping, align SAML NameID to email; check for duplicate externalIds before full sync." 

kevin_sre: I'll add a playbook entry with sample Okta mapping screenshots and the curl diagnostics. :white_check_mark:

dina_sales: closing — POC unblocked. :tada:
